scalars.scalar_value: Five (5) to Seven (7) years of clinical experience required

items.item_text: Current California Registered Nurse license - RN
Certification in Hospice and Palliative Care (CHPN)
Five (5) to Seven (7) years of clinical experience required
1 to 3 years of Hospice or Palliative Care experience preferred.

Promotes an interdisciplinary approach to Palliative care services within the hospital setting, encompassing the physical, psychosocial and spiritual dimensions of care. Measurement: Observation, Documentation, Feedback
Participates in daily unit rounds, assesses patients for palliative care and provides timely and consistent follow up. Measurement: Observation, Documentation, Feedback
Stays abreast of trends in pain and symptom management and acts as a clinical resource for hospital staff, patients and families. Measurement: Observation, Documentation, Education
Facilitates patient/family discussion regarding goals of care/advance health care planning. Coordinates conferences with physicians when appropriate. Measurement: Observation, Documentation, Feedback

Collaborates with the Director of Palliative Care Services, Medical Director, physicians and the interdisciplinary team to provide palliative care services to patients and families. Measurement: Observation, Documentation, Feedback
Demonstrates clinical competency in appropriate nursing areas, applying knowledge, skills, standards, clinical and ethical decision-making. Measurement: Observation, Documentation, Competency
